If these data are obtained, re-evaluate to decide whether plexiform neurofibroma is confirmed (and whether the child meets NF1 criteria or has segmental/mosaic NF1), or whether another diagnosis (shagreen patch/TSC, venous malformation, lipomatous lesion, epidermal nevus) is more likely.
